name: Storage
tagline: D1, KV, R2: sign-in, change rows, uploads
summary: DiffKit keeps very little on its own servers: sign-in records, a short list of recent GitHub changes, a few expiring cache keys, and images or videos uploaded into comments.

flow.label: Void config
flow.note: Binds D1 as DB, KV as GITHUB_CACHE_KV and R2 as COMMENT_MEDIA to the Worker.

flow.label: Drizzle schema
flow.note: Defines the six D1 tables that server code reads and writes through getDb().

flow.label: SQL migrations
flow.note: Nine numbered files, applied on deploy; the latest rebuilds github_change.

flow.label: Change row writes
flow.note: Webhooks upsert rows in the background; a failed write is dropped, never an error.

flow.label: Maintenance cron
flow.note: Every 5 minutes: deletes change rows older than 15 minutes and logs D1 size.

flow.label: KV heartbeat
flow.note: Each cron run writes a heartbeat key that /api/health reports back.

features.name: Sign-in tables
features.summary: user, session, account and verification are Better Auth's tables. account holds each user's GitHub OAuth and GitHub App tokens.

entry.role: First of the four Better Auth tables
Drizzle client over the D1 binding

features.name: Change feed table
features.summary: github_change keeps one row per repo and entity key with a version number. A repeat change updates the row, so the table stays small.

features.name: Forbidden orgs table
features.summary: user_forbidden_org remembers orgs that block the OAuth app, so searches skip them. Rows go away once the GitHub App is installed on the org.

entry.role: Reads and writes for this table

features.name: KV cache keys
features.summary: Four key families, all with a TTL: installation tokens, per-user readable repo lists (10 min), the cron heartbeat (24 h) and the landing star count (7 d).

features.name: Comment media bucket
features.summary: R2 stores comment uploads under a per-user prefix: images up to 25 MB, videos up to 120 MB, type checked from the file's first bytes.

features.name: Sweeper and size check
features.summary: The cron deletes change rows older than 15 minutes in batches and warns in the logs at 80% of D1's 10 GB limit or above 50k change rows.

entry.role: Runs the sweep and the size check

features.name: Migrations and CI check
features.summary: Nine migrations; 0007 drops the four cache tables behind the 2026-11-08 incident. A CI script blocks edited or destructive migrations without approval.

entry.role: Compares migrations with the Drizzle schema

entryPoints.symbol: Runbook: D1 database full or filling up

goodParts: Tests run real SQL: lib/testing/d1-sqlite.ts applies the migration files to an in-memory node:sqlite database behind a D1-shaped API.
The D1-full incident is written up in docs/platform-plan.md with a runbook; its rule (a TTL and sweeper for every store) is repeated in code comments.
watch: Sweeper batches are 20,000 rows with a 4 s pause (github-change.server.ts:15); platform-plan.md:68 notes that purge setting made about 12% of live change inserts fail.
The cron sweeps only github_change. Nothing in apps/dashboard deletes expired session or verification rows, or old R2 comment media.
Migration history is noisy: 0002 to 0004 create tables that 0007 drops, and 0006 creates github_change that 0008 drops and recreates.
